name: Intellinez Teams View for Elementor
author: intellinezwp

sections.description:
Intellinez Teams View for Elementor adds a team members widget to Elementor with four ready-made layout presets based on the Intellinez Team Group designs.

Features include:

  • Four design presets (Classic Cards, Name Band, Hover Overlay, Compact Avatar)
  • Five built-in color themes (Midnight Navy, Sage Green, Blush Coral, Slate Purple, Clean Blue)
  • Repeater-based team member management (photo, name, role, bio, social links, CTA buttons)
  • Responsive column controls
  • Section padding, grid gap, and optional custom accent color
  • Per-design optimized CSS loading for better performance

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Edit a page with Elementor and search for “INTLZ Team Members” in the widget panel.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and active.

How many team members can I add?

There is no hard limit. Add as many members as needed via the repeater control.
